text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Add the omitted claim-admissibility gate to the matrix**

This normative row makes claim admissibility depend only on the evidence tier, but AC15(d) requires additional inputs that the row never considers: a matched sweep-off control for comparative claims, repeated equal-size runs for variance, and a nonzero confirmed-defect denominator for recall and variance. An implementation following the matrix could therefore admit a comparative claim immediately at `real_pr_measured` without the required control evidence. Add a separate claim-admissibility row, or extend this row with those inputs, outcomes, and next actions.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
